title: 第013章 李老三就是个败家子第014章 成年野山羊新词条
slug: 我能给箭术加点从猎户到斩仙
content_zh:
一个快嘴的妇人率先挑起话头，眼里闪着羡慕的光。
“可不是嘛！”
另一个接茬，压低了声音，神神秘秘，
“我今早碰见李忠家的（王氏）去溪边洗衣裳，篮子里的鸡毛可没藏严实！
还有那李老三，瞧着背了弓又往山那边去了，精神头足着呢，跟换了个人似的！”
“真邪门了哈？就李玄那小子，以前肩不能扛手不能提的，见天往镇上溜，这咋突然就开了窍，成打猎的好手了？还连着有收获？”
有人表示怀疑。
“谁知道呢，许是李老汉泉下有灵，保佑他家了？又或者……”
先前那快嘴妇人左右看看，声音更低了，“撞了山神爷的运？”
就在这时，王氏挎着个空篮子，低着头从村外走来，看样子是去自家菜地摘了点晚茬的枯藤回来当柴火。
她本不想凑这热闹，平日里这些场合，她多是沉默避开，免得听人议论自家那不争气的小叔子和窘迫的光景。
“哎！
李忠家的！
这边！
正说你呢！”
那快嘴妇人眼尖，立刻扬声招呼。
王氏脚步一顿，心里有些打鼓，但众目睽睽之下，也不好直接走开，只得慢慢挪步过去。
“他婶子，你们……说啥呢？”
王氏声音不大，手指无意识地绞着篮子的系带。
“还能说啥？说你小叔子李玄呗！”

快嘴妇人热络地拉她近前，脸上堆满笑，
“快跟咱们说说，你家老三是不是真在山里得了啥宝贝？咋一下子这么能耐了？连着两天都有肉吃！
那香味，可把咱们馋坏了！”
旁边几个妇人也七嘴八舌地附和，眼神里满是好奇和探究，甚至带上了点以往没有的讨好。
王氏听着这些话，看着这些目光，心里那股憋屈了许久的郁气，忽然间就消散了许多。
往日因李玄的混账和李家的贫困，她在这些妇人堆里几乎插不上话。
偶尔提起也是旁人怜悯或嘲讽的对象，腰杆从未挺直过。
可如今……
她深吸一口气，努力让声音听起来平稳些，但微微扬起的下巴和眼底一闪而过的光彩，还是泄露了她的心绪：
“也没啥宝贝……就是玄小子他自己，好像突然懂事了，知道顾家了。”
她顿了顿，终究没忍住，添了几句，“这孩子，以前是混账了些，可心地不坏。
如今肯下力气，肯钻山，倒是把他爹和他爷爷早年留下的一点本事给捡起来了。
那山鸡，是他和他大哥一起设套弄的，箭法还挺准……”
这轻描淡写的几句话，却像在平静的水潭里扔下了石头。
content_en:
A fast-talking woman took the lead in starting the conversation, her eyes shining with envy.
"That's right!"
Another one followed, lowering his voice and speaking mysteriously,
“I met Li Zhong’s family (Wang) going to the stream to wash clothes this morning, but the chicken feathers in the basket were not well hidden!
And there was Li Laosan, who looked like he was heading to the other side of the mountain with his bow on his back. He was in high spirits, as if he was a different person! "
"How evil, huh? That kid Li Xuan, who couldn't carry it on his shoulders or lift it in his hands before, slipped into the town when the sky came up. Now he suddenly enlightened and became a good hunter? And he still has harvests?"
Some expressed doubts.
"Who knows, maybe Old Man Li has a spirit under his spring to bless his family? Or..."
The fast-talking woman looked around and her voice became even lower, "Are you lucky enough to be the mountain god?"
At this moment, Mrs. Wang walked from the outside of the village with an empty basket and her head lowered. It seemed that she had gone to her vegetable patch to pick some late-growing dead vines to use as firewood.
She didn't want to join in the fun. On weekdays, she mostly avoided these occasions silently, so as not to listen to people talking about her unsatisfactory brother-in-law and her embarrassing situation.
"Hey!
From the Li Zhong family!
This way!
I'm talking about you! "
The quick-talking woman had sharp eyes and immediately raised her voice to say hello.
Ms. Wang paused, feeling a little nervous, but in full view of the crowd, she couldn't just walk away, so she had to walk slowly over.
"His aunt, what are you...saying?"
Wang's voice was not loud, and her fingers were twisting the ties of the basket unconsciously.
"What else can you say? Let's talk about your brother-in-law Li Xuan!"
The quick-tongued woman pulled her closer warmly, with a smile on her face.
"Tell us, did your third child really get a treasure in the mountains? How did he become so capable all of a sudden? He had meat to eat for two days in a row!
The scent makes us greedy! "
Several women next to him also echoed in all directions, their eyes full of curiosity and inquiry, and even a little bit more flattering than before.
When Wang heard these words and looked at these eyes, the depression in her heart that had been held back for a long time suddenly dissipated a lot.
In the past, because of Li Xuan's misbehavior and the Li family's poverty, she could hardly speak among these women.
Occasionally, I was the object of pity or ridicule from others, but my waist was never straight.
But now...
She took a deep breath and tried to make her voice sound calmer, but the slightly raised chin and the flash of light in her eyes still revealed her thoughts:
"There's no treasure...it's just Mr. Xuan himself. He seems to have suddenly become sensible and knows about the Gu family."
She paused, but finally couldn't hold it back and added a few words, "This kid used to be a bit of a bastard, but he has a good heart.
Now that he is willing to work hard and climb into the mountains, he has picked up some of the skills left behind by his father and grandfather in their early years.
He and his elder brother set up that pheasant together, and their archery skills are quite accurate..."
These understatement words were like throwing stones into a calm pool.
